title: Data Validation Cookbook: Cars Rules
summary: A one-to-one port of the cookbook's opening validation workflow using the exact R cars data, four original rules, published counts, violating records, and canonical summary plot.

source.title: The Data Validation Cookbook — Introduction, quick example
source.copyright: Mark P. J. van der Loo
source.note: The selected example is ported with the exact built-in cars data values, rules, results, and byte-for-byte canonical PNG. No synthetic data or redrawn figure is used.

datasets.title: Speed and stopping distances of cars
